title: This Week’s MUST‑HAVE MSFS Add‑On:Dash 8-300 🛫 | Marketplace Update (PC)
description:
If you've been looking for new MSFS aircraft, the wait is over. In today's video, we break down all the new releases, including the Dash 8-300, new C-130J liveries, and immersive sound packs for the Bell 206B3. Whether you are a fan of regional turboprops or GA flying, this MSFS 2020 Marketplace update has something for you!

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Virtualcol FS Software: DASH 8-300 (New on PC and Xbox)

🎨 Captain Sim: C-130J-30 Livery Pack 3 (New on PC and Xbox)
🎨 2PILOT: ENHANCED COCKPIT GREEN LIGHTS (On sale: 1.99 | New on PC and Xbox)
🎨 2PILOT: NEW COCKPIT C172/152 & TBM WHITE (On sale: 1.99 | New on PC and Xbox)

If you enjoyed this Marketplace Update, drop a like 👍, subscribe for weekly MSFS news ✈️, and tell me in the comments which release you’re picking up first (Aerostar or Dash 8?)!

Thanks for watching and happy flying
